== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Reaper, also known as the [[Reaper of Worlds]], is a title associated with [[Reigan Shen]] and later [[Eithan]]. Originally an ascended weaponsmith possessing the memories of his craft, he became a figure of immense power and [[destruction]]. He is known for wielding a pitch-black The Scythe{{!}}Scythe capable of erasing remnants entirely, as well as a specialized [[sword]] designed for combat against high-level entities like Archlord{{!}}Archlords. His actions and presence have caused significant upheaval, including damaging planetary defenses and causing widespread fear among various organizations. While some view him as a deranged child or a living weapon, others recognize his role in managing the burdens of taking over worlds. Beyond the individual, the term refers to the [[Reaper Division]]. This group was established to serve as an eighth division within the [[Abidan]], tasked with removing threats to preserve existence. Operating under the leadership of Ozriel, the division functions by rescuing individuals from [[destruction]] and has successfully delayed or reversed the collapse of numerous worlds. Although some members of the [[Abidan]] view them as traitors, the division's primary purpose is to act as a stabilizing force across the universes.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Reaper is the newest member of a group of [[Abidan]] known as the Reapers, an organization whose powers function independently of Way{{!}}the Way and who are widely disdained by others, particularly those in the [[Wolf Division]]. Sent to [[Threshold]] by Ozriel as a baby, this agent was assigned to reclaim the [[Iteration]] and possesses an estimated base power comparable to a three-star [[Wolf]] with a specialty in stealth. Appearing as a figure of black and white, the Reaper wears black armor and features black hair, black eyes with burning white circle irises, and a [[white badge]] on his chest. During his time on [[Threshold]], the Reaper launched a mental assault on [[Cirian]], and his presence has caused strange deviations. The ultimate success of [[Lindon]]'s mission will serve to establish the reputation of the Reapers among the [[Abidan]].}}
